body: Procedural loops (ambience, sirens) are endless decoders played with PlaybackMode::Once; rejected PlaybackMode::Loop because rodio Repeat buffers every played sample of an endless source (unbounded memory).

Voice budget = own per-class cap with steal-oldest (Wwise 'discard oldest instance') enforced in Update before sinks exist; rejected switching to bevy_seedling (GDD 10.1 fallback) since the cap is ~40 lines and needs no new crate.

Wall-hit impact needs BulletTrace to say what the pellet hit: add `hit: TraceHit {Nothing, World, Body}` in gta_sim; rejected client-side inference by matching DamageDealt points and weapon range (float equality, reads another domain's config).
Red damage vignette uses Bevy 0.19.1 built-in `bevy::post_process::effect_stack::Vignette` on the camera (intensity 0 skips the pass); rejected a full-screen UI overlay image (needs a texture asset).

Spatial listener gets mirrored ear offsets (left=+X, right=-X) because rodio 0.22.2 Spatial::set_positions swaps the diff modifiers (spatial.rs:57-60; upstream master fixed the sign); gated with a rodio =0.22.2 dev-dependency probe. Alternative rejected: SpatialListener::new(gap) as planned + owner-ear check only (a mirrored pan is easy to miss and flips silently on the next rodio bump).

QA counts sounds through a reflected SoundStats resource (spawned per class, peak alive per class) instead of polling live Sound entities every 50 ms; alternative rejected: entity polling races 0.1-0.3 s one-shots that despawn when their sink drains on a host with an audio device.

Loop pause/play becomes an idempotent per-frame sync on GameState instead of OnEnter/OnExit(Paused) one-shots; alternative rejected: a sink created in PostUpdate after OnEnter(Paused) would keep playing through the pause.

Death sting = music-jingles jingles_SAX01 (descending ~0.8 oct over 0.89 s, mellow sax = 'глухой'), chosen by pitch-contour ranking of all 102 jingles; alternatives PIZZI01/NES11/STEEL01 go on the owner checklist. Rejected: HIT-series (short, not descending).

Player hurt = non-spatial 'hurt' pool reusing the five impactPunch_heavy files in its own SoundClass::Hurt (cap 2), so heavy NPC fire cannot steal it through the Impact cap; impact-sounds manifest stays 26 files, music-jingles becomes 3. Rejected: a new manifest file (no other heavy body variant in the pack) and putting hurt in Impact/Stinger classes.
SoundStats.spawned counted at spawn time in one spawn helper instead of in enforce_voice_budget after trimming; V2's order would count at most cap per frame and make G-A3's spawned==30k impossible.
PlayerHurt and StarsRaised are field-less messages; the plan's amount/stars fields were never read and failed clippy -D warnings (dead_code). Rejected: #[allow(dead_code)] on data nobody consumes.

SoundBank is built by FromWorld in SoundCuesPlugin::build (init_resource) instead of a Startup system, so spawn_ambience (Startup) needs no ordering edge; GameAudioPlugin calls add_audio_source::<Synth>() first. Rejected: Startup build_sound_bank + .after() across two plugins.

star_pulse_scale rows of G-J3 live in src/hud/stars.rs tests (the fn is pub(super) in the private hud::stars module); arc_angle rows stay in juice/feedback_gate.rs. Rejected: widening hud::stars visibility for a test.

t13.py: resuming from Paused over BRP failed: NextState<GameState> is not registered for reflection (world.insert_resources -> not registered), and the Escape hold cannot release while Time<Virtual> is paused (brp_extras keys.rs ticks Res<Time>). Pause phase moved to the end of the run instead of registering NextState in QaRemotePlugin.

t13.py: teleporting to CityLandmarks.park_center lands on the SMG pickup, so the following 'unarmed' melee phase fired an SMG. Ambience is now checked on the park range after the melee phase (the range is inside the park), and melee asserts the player is unarmed first.
t13 ambience check uses park gain >= 0.9*park_volume (AmbienceMix holds gains, not the park weight); the plan's literal 'AmbienceMix.park > 0.9' could never pass with park_volume 0.35.

Verdict NEEDS_WORK over PASS: detect_player_hurt fires a false PlayerHurt on Busted respawn with armour (same entity, Health::full drops armour); suggested fix = compare only in GameState::Playing and reset the Local otherwise, rejected keying on sim damage messages as larger.

m2: impacts are de-duplicated per (attack id, hit a body) via a new BulletTrace.attack field equal to ShotFired.attack, not per fixed tick. One blast's pellets are always written in one tick, so this is strictly finer than per-tick and needs no FixedUpdate presentation system. Rejected: moving play_impacts (or a dedupe queue) into FixedUpdate.

m1: the death sting has its own SoundClass::DeathSting with data cap voices.death_sting=1, so a wanted stinger can no longer steal it at any state timing. Rejected: dropping StarsRaised outside Playing, which depends on the order of JuicePlugin and SoundCues in one frame. t13.py CLASSES/regex and the death phase now use DeathSting.

m3: sirens use max_emitters Synth assets whose sweeps start at period*i/max_emitters, handed out round-robin; no new tuning number. Rejected: PlaybackSettings.start_position, because rodio skip_duration skips eagerly on the main thread (up to 216k samples per spawn), and a data detune, which still starts both sirens in unison.

M1: detect_player_hurt compares only in GameState::Playing and forgets the pool in every other state, Paused included, as the orchestrator prescribed. The cost is that a hit landing in the first fixed tick after a resume or respawn is missed. Rejected: keeping the pool through Paused, a second branch for a hit that is rarer than one tick.

Siren desync is verified headless (sirens_ride_live_cops, round-robin starts) plus code reading, not at runtime: AudioPlayer<Synth> is not reflected, so BRP cannot tell which start a live siren uses. Rejected: adding a reflection registration to production code for QA.

t9 red in 1 of 3 runs (gang members in Attack fired 0 rounds in 6 s) is filed as a pre-existing flake, not a TASK-014 regression: the only sim change is BulletTrace gaining hit/attack fields and a read moved above the write; no AI reads BulletTrace. Rejected: rebuilding the base commit in place for an A/B of a timing flake.

Hurt cue min interval is enforced in audio play_hurt (Local last-play time on Time<Real>, mix.ron hurt.min_interval 0.5 s), not in juice detect_player_hurt; alternative (throttle PlayerHurt at the source) rejected because it would also thin the vignette and trauma, which must keep accumulating.

Siren hysteresis lives in pure pick_sirens(carried, margin): carriers stay while live and within audible, free slots fill nearest-first, a carrier yields only to a cop closer by more than siren.switch_margin (10 m). Alternative (a minimum hold time per cop) rejected: it would still hop between two cops at similar distance every hold period.

Vignette retuned in juice.ron (per_hurt 0.45, max 0.65, decay 0.45/s, radius 0.85, smoothness 2.0). Runtime probe showed the old tint was visible when captured early (+55 edge redness at intensity 0.24 on the street) but died in 0.44 s and plateaued at 0.05-0.23 under 2.7 hits/s; alternative (only raising per_hurt) rejected because the fast decay would still keep sustained fire far below the cap.
